q1_issues.issue: The KindProperty claim is left unrestricted — the text says corruption was widespread *in Persia*, not widespread at large, and the restriction is stripped off the property atom.

(LocatedIn corruption persia) puts a bare kind/mass symbol in a head specified for 'where a THING is' (an entity), and it is asserted untensed while the property it is meant to restrict is Past-wrapped.
(Inheritance discipline lax) asserts laxness of discipline in general, whereas the subject is the specific 'discipline in the army'.
(LocatedIn discipline sk_army_1) again places a kind in the entity slot and treats an army (an organization) as a containing place.

q2_gaps: a locative / restrictive PP scoping a kind-level or mass-noun property claim ('corruption was widespread **in Persia**', 'discipline **in the army** was lax') — nothing states whether it goes in ConditionalProperty's condition slot (the 'Trailers are permitted on the causeway' precedent), becomes a LocatedIn atom, or restricts a witness

abstract mass-noun subject of a copular clause (corruption, discipline) — the individual-vs-kind test decides Member vs Inheritance and the plural rule decides by determiner, but no rule covers a bare or post-modified mass noun in subject position
notes: KindProperty for 'widespread' (an explicitly listed non-distributing property) and the absence of any connective atom for clausal 'and' are both correct. The Degree atom's (STV 0.9 0.9) is also odd, since a degree level is not a proportion.
